summary: Every ask hit of GET /api/v1/search carries `ask` (model.SearchAsk: state open|answered|resolved, the latest answer, the resolution), filled by a new helper attachAskStates (api/search_ask.go) that runFusedSearchQuery and runMeaningSearch call after scanSearchRows; `dispatch search` prints that state under each ask hit with the full answer text; the web palette shows a status line (Answered/Closed, no answer/Closed after an answer/Open) under each ask hit's excerpt; the excerpt's ask text becomes question || ask_search_suffix(options, answer) instead of raw options JSON.

server: model/model.go: type SearchAsk {State string `json:"state"`; Answer *AskAnswer `json:"answer,omitempty"`; Resolution *AskResolution `json:"resolution,omitempty"`}; SearchResult.Ask *SearchAsk `json:"ask,omitempty"`, set on every ask hit, nil on other kinds. Answer.Selected never null on the wire.

api/search_ask.go: func (s *server) attachAskStates(ctx, q queryer, results []model.SearchResult) error: one query `select id::text, state, answer, resolution from asks where id = any($1::uuid[])` for ask hits; only when a resolved ask hit is present, s.loadAskAnswersByAsk for those ids and take the last answer (legacy rows retracted while answered keep the answer only in events, ask_answer_change_test.go:188-202). Called by runFusedSearchQuery and runMeaningSearch after scanSearchRows, inside TookMS; an error propagates like a search-query error. An ask deleted between the reads keeps Ask nil.
api/search.go:136: the txt lateral's ask arm becomes k.question || ' ' || ask_search_suffix(k.options, k.answer) (the indexed text, 0019/0060), replacing options::text JSON. The only SQL change.
suggestions.go and WriteSuggestion are untouched: dispatch://INFRA-568 copies result.Ask into its related items.
design.contracts: packages/contracts/src/dispatch-api.ts: export type SearchAsk = {state:"open"} | {state:"answered"; answer: AskAnswer} | {state:"resolved"; resolution: AskResolution; answer?: AskAnswer}; SearchResult.ask?: SearchAsk. dispatch-tools.ts dispatch_search description gains one sentence on ask hits.
design.cli: packages/envoy-client/src/search-answer.ts: the hit line is unchanged; an ask hit adds `  Answered by <user> at <at> · options chosen: <labels|none>` and `  Answer text: <text|none>` (later lines of the text indented four spaces); `  Closed with no answer: <kind> by <actor> at <at>: <reason>`; `  Closed after an answer: …` then `  Last answer by …` and `  Answer text: …`; `  Open: no answer yet.`; an ask hit with no `ask`: `  Answer state not reported by this Dispatch; open the link to read the ask.` actorText moves out of dispatch-execute.ts into a shared module (no copy).
design.web: packages/dispatch/web/src/features/search/SearchPalette.tsx ResultOption: a status line under the excerpt when result.ask is set: badge Answered + user · Timestamp + `· Chose <labels>` or `· No option chosen` + answer text MarkdownPreview clamped to 3 lines; badge `Closed, no answer` + AskResolutionLine · Timestamp; badge `Closed after an answer` + resolution + last answer; badge Open. The kind badge stays first (accessible name still starts `ask `).
